answers.business: We install residential and commercial solar systems for homeowners and small businesses in Ilocos.
answers.products:
Residential install at 1,200,000 pesos
Commercial install at 4,500,000 pesos, and commercial needs a site survey first
answers.deal: About 1,500,000 a deal, and three reps take calls
answers.fulfilment: Six people, and our own crew does the installs
answers.owner: It is me, with one operations assistant
answers.close: Two calls. First we qualify and do the survey, then we present the proposal
answers.sources:
Google Ads about 25 a month, tracked
Facebook about 18 a month, tracked
Walk-ins about 10 a month, not tracked
answers.capture: They land in a spreadsheet, and I use HubSpot Starter plus WhatsApp and Excel
answers.volumes: 55 leads a month, I close 12, so about 22 percent, and three weeks from first call to signed
answers.headache: Follow-ups slip and I have no visibility on who is where in the process

answers.business: We run a dental clinic in Ilocos with four chairs and general plus cosmetic dentistry.
answers.products:
General check-up at 1,500 pesos
Whitening at 8,000 pesos, after an evaluation
Implants at 45,000 pesos, after an x-ray and treatment plan
answers.deal: About 6,000 a typical deal, and two people take calls
answers.fulfilment: Four dentists and two assistants, we deliver everything in-house
answers.close: One call, they book the first visit straight away
answers.sources:
Google about 30 a month, tracked
Referrals about 12 a month, not tracked
Walk-ins about 40 a month, not tracked
answers.capture: We book in Excel and take messages on WhatsApp, no CRM
answers.volumes: 80 leads a month, we close about 60, so roughly 75 percent, and the cycle is two weeks
answers.spend: 30,000 on Google and a bit of Facebook, 5,000 on software
answers.headache: No-shows and no follow-up, so people book and then disappear
answers.goal: 30 percent more bookings and fewer no-shows

answers.business: We do aircon and plumbing service and installation for homes in and around Ilocos.
answers.products:
AC service at 2,500 pesos
AC installation at 18,000 pesos
Plumbing repair at 1,800 pesos
answers.deal: Around 12,000 a typical job, four people take calls
answers.fulfilment: Eight technicians, our own team does all the work
answers.owner: Me, and my brother handles the jobs
answers.close: Two calls usually. One to quote, one to confirm the slot
answers.sources:
Website about 35 a month, tracked
Phone calls about 50 a month, not tracked
Referrals about 10 a month, not tracked
answers.capture: Paper and WhatsApp, no CRM at all
answers.volumes: 90 leads a month, we finish about 18 jobs, so 20 percent, and a week from call to job
answers.headache: We miss calls all the time and I have no idea how many jobs are in the pipeline

answers.business: We sell single-origin coffee online in the Philippines, mostly subscriptions and hampers.
answers.products:
Subscription box at 950 pesos a month
Single-origin bag at 450 pesos
Corporate hampers at 3,500 pesos
answers.deal: About 1,200 a typical order, one person handles the phone
answers.fulfilment: Five people, we pack and ship from our own warehouse
answers.close: One call, and most orders are self-checkout online
answers.sources:
Instagram about 200 a month, tracked
Google about 80 a month, tracked
Email about 120 a month, tracked
answers.capture: Shopify and Mailchimp, no real CRM
answers.volumes: 400 leads a month, we convert about 150, so roughly 38 percent, and it is same week
answers.headache: Repeat purchase is flat, so everything depends on new customers
answers.goal: 30 percent more revenue in six months
